parts.text: Write a short company-wide announcement (under 120 words, English): from Dec 1, all expense reports must be submitted through the new system; paper forms will not be accepted after Nov 30.

**Subject: Important Update: New Expense Reporting System**

Dear Team,

Please be advised that starting **December 1**, all expense reports must be submitted through our new digital expense management system. 

Legacy paper forms will no longer be accepted after **November 30**. To ensure a smooth transition, please familiarize yourself with the new platform ahead of the deadline. Training materials and login instructions are available on the intranet. 

Thank you for your cooperation as we upgrade our processes. 

Best regards,

Finance Team
